issue_title: gitAuthArgs substring host check leaks service token to attacker hosts

members.text: The host check is a substring match, so a remote URL such as `https://github.com.evil.example/x.git` passes and receives the service token in an `Authorization` header. Any user who can register a repository can collect the token.

issue_title: gitAuthArgs substring host check leaks service token to attacker hosts

members.text: `cloneRepo` passes the user-supplied `remoteUrl` straight to `gitAuthArgs` with the service token, so `git clone` sends the token to whatever host the URL names.

issue_title: Unhandled user-fetch failures reject loadDashboard and crash the page

members.text: `fetchCurrentUser` rejects on any non-2xx status, and `loadDashboard` does not catch it.
`loadDashboard` awaits `fetchCurrentUser` and `fetchUserList` with no error handling. A failed request from either one rejects the dashboard load, and the page never renders.

issue_title: Repository id not validated, allowing path traversal in registerRepo/template routes

members.text: The repository id is stored with no character or path validation and later used as a directory name. An id such as `../../etc` or an absolute path such as `/etc` escapes the repositories directory on both the template route and the cache listing route.
The template route builds its base directory from the raw repository id. CLAUDE.md invariant 1 requires every route to validate repository ids before using them.

issue_title: Store.deleteRepo filter lets non-admins delete system-owned repositories

members.text: The delete route applies no ownership check of its own and relies on `Store.deleteRepo`, whose filter lets a non-admin delete system-owned repositories.

issue_title: Store.deleteRepo filter lets non-admins delete system-owned repositories

members.text: For a non-admin caller the delete also matches rows whose owner is `system`, so any authenticated user can delete shared system repositories.

issue_title: getBuild CI request has no timeout or abort signal

members.text: The CI build request has no timeout or abort signal, so a stalled CI response hangs every caller of `getBuild`.

issue_title: ADMIN_CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 makes every client an admin for auditLog

members.text: The admin allowlist is `0.0.0.0/0`, which spans `0.0.0.0`–`255.255.255.255`, so every client address counts as an admin network and `auditLog` serves the audit log to anyone.

issue_title: No tests for encrypt/decrypt round trip and tamper detection

members.text: No tests cover `encrypt` and `decrypt`, including the round trip and tamper detection.

issue_title: getIssue Jira request has no timeout or abort signal

members.text: The Jira request has no timeout or abort signal, so a stalled Jira response hangs every caller of `getIssue`.

issue_title: searchAssigned interpolates unescaped email into JQL query

members.text: `searchAssigned` puts `email` into the JQL string without escaping. A value containing `"` rewrites the query. Escape `\` and `"` before interpolating.

issue_title: createFixTask race: task running before feedback written, stale emit

members.text: `createFixTask` inserts the task as `running` with `feedback: null` and writes the feedback in a second statement. `poll` can pick the task up between the two writes and run it without feedback, and `emit` sends `{ ...task }` with the stale `null` feedback.
